addDestination.title: Add backup destination
addDestination.description: Pick where restic keeps the repository: a local folder or an rclone remote.
addDestination.kitDescription: Download or copy the kit. Athena never shows this password again; without it a dead host can't restore.
addDestination.saveKitFirst: Save the recovery kit before creating the destination
addDestination.name: Name
addDestination.folderHint: Absolute path, outside the Athena data folder.
addDestination.remoteHint: An rclone remote already set up on Cloud → Remotes.
addDestination.passwordPlaceholder: Leave empty to generate a strong one
addDestination.passwordHint: Leave empty to have Athena generate a strong password. It's shown once below, then never again.
addDestination.kitSaved: I saved this recovery kit (password, destination and restic version)

addPlan.title: Add backup plan
addPlan.description: Pick what to back up, where, and how often. Apps are stopped during their backup unless "Back up while running" is on.
addPlan.name: Name
addPlan.athena: Back up Athena (settings, DB, secrets, TLS)
addPlan.userFilesHint: Everyone's personal folders (My files). On by default.
addPlan.appsHint: Which apps to include in the plan.
addPlan.noApps: No apps found. Start apps from Store → Apps first.
addPlan.scheduleHint: Leave empty for manual runs only. Scheduled runs come with part 4.
addPlan.retentionHint: `restic forget --keep-…` per item. Defaults: 7 daily / 4 weekly / 6 monthly.
